feat(scene): add scene schema and validator stub first slice (#11)

Phase-1 work bundle PR-C, first implementation slice for the
`chromaticity-scene` crate. Reserves the canonical-model module
topology (`schema` + `validator`) with std-only, internal-only
Rust types so the `EV-SCENE-IMPORT` baseline test has something
to hang off while the full schema and symbol-catalog parser land
in follow-up slices.

Why this shape: the scene-import pipeline needs a `Scene` /
`SceneHeader` / `PassSpec` skeleton and a `validate()` entry
point before the canonical-model normalizer can begin populating
them. Field names here are `pub(crate)` or private on purpose —
this slice does NOT lock the `.chroma` JSON surface, which is
why the commit carries `Profile-Impact: none`. Serde derives and
the full field set wait on the schema-freeze work.

The validator stub documents `docs/36-reactive-symbol-catalog.md`
as the authoritative symbol source the real validator will read;
it does not parse the catalog yet. `ValidationError` ships with a
single `UnknownSymbol(String)` variant so the failure path is
constructible from tests and so later variants (range errors,
pass-wiring errors, ADR-008 transition-hook errors) land against
a known surface.

Files touched:
- engine/scene/src/lib.rs     (wire `pub mod schema; pub mod
                               validator;`; refresh module
                               docstring with EV-SCENE-IMPORT
                               pointer)
- engine/scene/src/schema.rs  (new; `Scene`, `SceneHeader`,
                               `PassSpec`, all crate-private
                               fields)
- engine/scene/src/validator.rs (new; `validate` no-op,
                                 `ValidationError::UnknownSymbol`,
                                 two `#[test]`s tagged for
                                 `EV-SCENE-IMPORT`)

Governing docs:
- docs/adr/ADR-007-scene-warm-switch-policy.md
- docs/adr/ADR-008-transition-and-traveler-semantics.md
- docs/36-reactive-symbol-catalog.md (named, not edited)
- docs/26-evidence-artifact-registry.md line 23 (`EV-SCENE-IMPORT`)
- docs/43-development-standards.md §12.1
